graph.title: LEGO Minecraft 21113 The Cave

new_part_types.name: Brick 1x1/1x2 with side bar (ladder holder, light gray)
Minifig torso (Zombie, cyan shirt green hands)
Plate 2x2 with centre stud (bright green, grass)

notes: Booklet has 3 numbered bags' worth of builds: bag 1 = Cave + Steve; bag 2 = spider, Zombie, grass/TNT section, treasure-chest top and accessories. All are modelled as ONE connected model (the grass/TNT section and the chest platform clip onto the cave in steps 9-10 and 6).
The 'Rebuild Inspiration' pages (36-39) re-use the same parts in a different arrangement; not modelled separately.

Piece sizes/colours were read from the inventory (page 47) and parts boxes; some element IDs not in the catalogue were given new types with approximate names (e.g. 4211385=brick 2x4, 4211795=2x6, 6037399=2x8, 4617862=2x10). Piece counts per element ID were cross-checked against the inventory (e.g. 43x 2x2 bricks, 17x dark plate w/ stud, 24x round 1x1 gray).

Exact stud-to-stud positions are inferred from isometric pictures; each piece is joined to the piece it rests on (stud.top of lower piece to anti-stud.bottom of upper piece). Some plates/bricks that sit flush with a plate and overhang its edge are joined to the brick below that supplies the studs.
Several steps show sub-assemblies upside-down (steps 2-3, 6 and the chest base); they are modelled in their final orientation.

The 'ore' sandwiches (2x2 plate, 4 gray 1x1 plates, 4 coloured round plates, top plate with stud) are ambiguous in layering; coloured round plates are linked with null ports. Cave: 2 orange + 1 red; Grass section: 2 dark gray (614126) + 1 tan. Attach points (which caps they sit on) approximate the pictures.
The ten 'capblock' copies (brick + dark plate with stud) are the 5x sub-assemblies of steps 13 and 15; copies 1-5 are step 13 and 6-10 are step 15.

Spider legs: each of the four 'legunit' copies (leg-pair element, clip plate, plate) clips onto an arm of one of two T-shaped pins that insert into the side holes of the body bricks; the exact leg-element joint is approximated.
Torch pole 4538950 uses catalogue ports bar.shaft (bottom) and stud.end (top) as an approximation.
The loose orange round plate (b120) from step 7, plus the finished minifigs/spider/bucket, are not fixed to the main model (b120 has no edges).
The bread rests in the chest (contact only); the chest lid is hinged to the base.
